verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 ships its own management software, so event-driven automation is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only shows health monitoring, system alerts and management interfaces (Redfish, IPMI, SNMP). Nothing documents user-defined rules that trigger actions automatically on events, and built-in alerts are an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
